description: Unit test code for the TextFileReader class in the webkitpy.style.filereader module, testing file processing, error handling, and internal state.

classes.name: TextFileReaderTest
classes.description: A unittest class for testing the TextFileReader functionality, including file processing and error handling.

classes.name: MockProcessor
classes.description: A mock processor class used within the tests to record process() calls.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes filesystem, temp directory, processor, and file reader.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by removing temporary directories.

methods.name: _create_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with specified text content.

methods.name: _passed_to_processor
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters passed to the mock processor.

methods.name: _assert_file_reader
methods.description: Asserts the internal state of the file reader matches expected processed calls and file count.

methods.name: test_process_file__does_not_exist
methods.description: Tests processing a non-existent file, expects SystemExit and logs error.

methods.name: test_process_file__is_dir
methods.description: Tests processing a directory path, expects warning log and no processing.

methods.name: test_process_file__should_not_process
methods.description: Tests that files ending with 'should_not_process.txt' are skipped.

methods.name: test_process_file__multiple_lines
methods.description: Tests processing a file with multiple lines and different line endings.

methods.name: test_process_file__file_stdin
methods.description: Tests processing a file with path '-' as stdin, with an extra keyword argument.

methods.name: test_process_file__with_kwarg
methods.description: Tests processing a file with an additional keyword argument.

methods.name: test_process_paths
methods.description: Tests processing a list of paths including files and directories.
